Five lazy depth caches each own one reference per inserted expression. Depth zero performs no cache allocation or INC. Table construction precedes key INC; growth/insertion follows it. A refused insertion retains that exact pending INC for owning closure. Reset visits depths one through five and table buckets in source order, resets only size>=condition or condition zero, and records actual DEC consumption even when child deletion returns an error. Owning Close resumes that cleanup cursor without a second DEC. Successful cache hits read only key/hash/bounds, erasing numeral/child traversal. Fresh cold campaigns close cache/extraction/AST/numeric/symbol owners to zero shared budget.

The AST-owned address-stable c_val scope copies stored numerical metadata without normalization and holds that rational across subsequent AST calls through output publication. Nonnumeral default rational bookkeeping is erased. The unsigned numeral constructor is captured before entry, joined before older c_val DT and never retried at the same call site. Body and source-DT completion are separate; source readiness does not become true merely because owning cleanup ran. Successful scopes retire their exact invocation; failed scopes retain their actual plugin-list frame/context/header until plugin owning Close. Copied, ended, premature cleanup and uncaptured stopped-younger scopes reject. Actual Runtime campaigns refuse every reached read/constructor reservation until success and close the shared graph to zero budget.

Actual recursive call sites retain their entered structural frame and exact numerical invocation, captured at numerical frame entry before copy/two/division allocations. Successful returns retire before loop reuse; failed call sites reject reuse after owning cleanup. ADD constructs vector then tmp and destroys tmp then vector; MUL constructs tmp then vector/c_val and ends c_val then vector then tmp; CONCAT constructs new_last then vector and ends vector then new_last; equality constructs out1 then out2 and ends out2 then out1. A stopped exact child blocks older source DT. Failed vector pushes retain their exact unpublished INC receipt and original vector token across vector destruction, and owning closure acknowledges that acquisition once. AST ref/vector APIs record physical DEC consumption independently of later deletion errors. Reached frames remain on the actual owner list after body/source failure; owning Close drains youngest frames and numerical calls before pending cache INC/reset, without source replay or ambient-frame adoption.
deviations: All count/cache/removal/equality algorithm bodies are now selected, but whole-unit methods/ownership and native ABI are not credited. Source TRACE/CTRACE diagnostics and native stack/vtable/pointer/allocator/fatal/assertion/exception ABI remain open. Go returning-error cleanup is not native-fatal resumability. Whole-unit status is partial, not ported.

Source edge behavior is retained: concat passes the full request to every child and can over-remove; an unknown child leaves new_last unchanged, so concat(x,zero4) removal of six returns four/null in release and reaches the full-width SASSERT in g3debug. These are qualifications, not repaired algorithms.
